## Summary

What does this change do, and why? Link the issue it fixes.

## Test plan

The commands you ran and their output. For a change to an example, say which
browser or agent surface you exercised it on.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, or it needs none.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for any API change.
- [ ] `yarn build` and `yarn test` pass in every workspace you touched.
- [ ] You have signed the [CLA](https://code.facebook.com/cla).

Accepted contributions are reviewed and landed in Meta's internal repository,
so this pull request closes as merged once the change syncs back out. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full process.
